shortDescription: Create, modify, and idempotently manage yaml files.

options.name: append
options.description: Whether to append to an array/list. When the key does not exist or is null, a new array is created. When the key is of a non-list type, nothing is done.

options.name: backup
options.description: Whether to make a backup copy of the current file when performing an edit.

options.name: content
options.description: Content represents the yaml content you desire to work with.  This could be the file contents to write or the inmemory data to modify.

options.name: content_type
options.description: The python type of the content parameter.

options.name: curr_value
options.description: Used in conjunction with the update parameter.  This is the current value of 'key' in the yaml file.

options.name: curr_value_format
options.description: Format of the incoming current value.

options.name: edits
options.description: A list of edits to perform. These follow the same format as a single edit

options.name: index
options.description: Used in conjunction with the update parameter.  This will update a specific index in an array/list.

options.name: key
options.description: The path to the value you wish to modify. Emtpy string means the top of the document.

options.name: separator
options.description: The separator being used when parsing strings.

options.name: src
options.description: The file that is the target of the modifications.

options.name: state
options.description: State represents whether to create, modify, delete, or list yaml

options.name: update
options.description: Whether the update should be performed on a dict/hash or list/array object.

options.name: value_type
options.description: The python type of the incoming value.
